title: Microsoft Purview: view-only role management for Global Reader and Security Reader
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented controls and general Purview licensing requirement are supported. One minor clarification remains: the Entra Global Reader reference says Purview is unsupported, while the Purview permissions page maps that role to a Purview role group.
